items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: But he got me with Duke Ellington on the Ed Sullivan Show and we made an album.

ctx.x: Did any of the record dates stand out over the last ten years?

Oh yeah, with Duke Ellington. I was at -- I think Stanley Dance was the cause of -- he threw quite a few things, he was one of the fellas that threw things my way. I may have goofed up somewhere, but he's a good friend, He writes good. But he got me with Duke Ellington on the Ed Sullivan Show and we made an album. By my shyness I didn't play. I just strummed along, because I'm waitin' for Duke to tell me to do somethin'. He never said nothin'. And the bass player, I think his name was Joe Franklin. He said, "Play…
glad to be there. I guess if he had wanted me to play, he'd have, you know.
